context_for_next_testing_agent: Data Import feature is fully functional. Backend APIs support importing: employees, customers, suppliers, inventory, invoices, purchases, and financial data (revenues/expenses). Each import endpoint validates the file, maps columns (supports both Arabic and English column names), creates records in MongoDB, and saves import history. Frontend has a dedicated Import Data page accessible from sidebar with cards for each import type, a modal for file upload with template download, and import history table. Arabic language support works correctly with RTL layout.
